SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

S. 1, Special Branch Station / File No. ________________ Date June 17, 1941.

（右上角印章及手写内容：SHANGHAI POLICE REGISTRY 9601 (e) 7 7 41）

SUBJECT: "General Labour Unrest Report" - permission solicited to discontinue.

Permission is solicited to discontinue the "General Labour Unrest Report" submitted in the middle of every month. This report is a repetition of work because its contents and appended statistics can be found in the "General Monthly Report."

The "General Labour Unrest Report" was started following a sudden wave of labour unrest arising out of an increase in the cost of living at the end of 1939, but what was then considered extraordinary occurrences has now become ordinary routine matter and there is little or nothing contained in this report that is not already given in the labour part of the General Monthly Report. The labour saved by discontinuing this report can be better used in compiling labour records and statistics, etc..

W. C. Wilcox.
D. S. I.

A.C. (Special Branch)

S. 1, 特科分局 / 档案号 ___ 日期 1941年6月17日。

（右上角印章及手写内容：上海警务处档案室 9601 (e) 7 7 41）

主题：“劳工动荡总报告”——请求停止提交。

现请求停止提交每月中旬呈报的“劳工动荡总报告”。该报告属于重复性工作，因为其内容及所附统计数据均可见于《月度总报告》中。

“劳工动荡总报告”始于1939年底因生活成本上涨而引发的突发劳工动荡浪潮，但当时被视为异常的事件如今已成为日常例行事务，且该报告中所载内容几乎无一不包含在《月度总报告》的劳工部分中。停止该报告所节省的人力可更好地用于编制劳工记录和统计数据等。

W. C. Wilcox.
副督察长 (D. S. I.)

助理处长 (特科)

（左侧边缘有模糊手写批注，难以辨认，此处转录不清）

停止

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特科 1941年3月 助理处长）

Zung 先生。
请知悉。

S. 1, Special Branch Statistical File No. ____ Date May 22, 1941.

SUBJECT: General Labour Unrest between April 15 and May 14, 1941.

Between April 15 and May 14, 1941, 24 strikes and three cases of unrest occurred in the International Settlement and Extra-Settlement Roads Area as against 42 strikes and two cases of unrest occurring between March 15 and April 14, 1941.

In addition, 13 strikes and two cases of unrest extended from previous periods, bringing the total number of labour disputes existing during the period under review to 42 as against 51 existing during the previous period.

Of the 37 strikes declared during the period under review and/or extended from previous periods, 27 were settled through concessions being granted by the managements, six came to an end through the workers resuming work unconditionally, whilst the remaining four were still outstanding at the end of the period, May 14. These strikes involved a total of 21,779 workers, which figure shows a decrease of 1,147 as compared with the number of strikers (22,926) during the preceding period.

Of the five cases of unrest, which either took place during the period under review or extended from previous periods, four were settled amicably whilst the remaining one was still outstanding on May 14. These cases of unrest affected 4,680 workers.

Details of these disputes are given in an appendix attached hereto.

（印：... 22 1941 ... SPECIAL BRANCH）

S. 1, 特科统计档案号 ____ 日期 1941年5月22日。

主题：1941年4月15日至5月14日期间的劳工总体动荡情况。

1941年4月15日至5月14日期间，公共租界及越界筑路区域发生罢工24起、动荡事件3起；相比之下，1941年3月15日至4月14日期间发生罢工42起、动荡事件2起。

此外，另有13起罢工和2起动荡事件由前期延续而来，使得审查期内的劳工纠纷总数达到42起，而上一时期为51起。

在审查期内宣布和/或从前期延续的37起罢工中，27起因资方作出让步而解决，6起因工人无条件复工而结束，其余4起截至5月14日期末仍未解决。这些罢工共涉及工人21,779名，与上一时期的罢工人数（22,926名）相比减少了1,147名。

在审查期内发生或从前期延续的5起动荡事件中，4起已和平解决，另1起截至5月14日仍未解决。这些动荡事件影响了4,680名工人。

这些纠纷的详情见附后的附录。

（印：... 1941年5月22日 ... 特科）

SECRET

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE. No. S. P. D. 9601 (2)
29 A 41

REPORT

S. I., Special Branch /Station. File No. _______________ Date April 28, 1941.

SUBJECT: General Labour Unrest between March 15, and April 14, 1941.

Between March 15 and April 14, 1941, 51 labour disputes occurred at concerns in the Settlement and extra-Settlement roads Area as against 32 cases recorded between February 15 and March 14, 1941.

Of this number, strikes were declared in 45 cases, two of which were continued after the period ending March 14. In two of the strikes, the workers resumed unconditionally, whilst 30 were brought to an end through concessions being granted by the management. The remaining thirteen were still outstanding on April 14. These strikes involved a total of 22,926 workers, which figure shows an increase of 15,703 as compared with the number of strikers (7,223) during the preceding period.

The remaining six labour disputes were cases of unrest, one of which was continued after the period ending March 14, and affected 7,840 workers. Four of these cases were amicably settled, while the other remained unsettled on April 14.

Details of these disputes are given in an appendix attached hereto.

During this period, Police records show that the Shanghai Labour Unions Readjustment Committee, Lane 247, 5 Chung Hwa Road, Nantao, had connections with two disputes and the Shanghai Branch of the Social Movement Direction Committee 527 Range Road had connections with thirteen disputes. These cases are as follows :-

Disputes in which the Shanghai Labour Unions Readjustment Committee was concerned.

29 A 41

报告

特别支部/巡捕房。档案号 ___ 日期 1941年4月28日。

主题：1941年3月15日至4月14日期间的一般劳工骚动。

1941年3月15日至4月14日期间，租界及越界筑路地区的商号发生了51起劳资纠纷，而1941年2月15日至3月14日期间记录的案件为32起。

在这些案件中，有45起宣布罢工，其中两起延续至3月14日之后。在两起罢工中，工人无条件复工，而30起因资方作出让步而结束。其余13起截至4月14日仍未解决。这些罢工共涉及22,926名工人，与前一时期罢工人数（7,223人）相比，增加了15,703人。

其余6起劳资纠纷为骚动案件，其中一起延续至3月14日之后，涉及7,840名工人。其中四起案件已友好解决，另一起截至4月14日仍未解决。

这些纠纷的详情见附后的附录。

在此期间，警方记录显示，位于南市中华路5号247弄的上海工会整理委员会与两起纠纷有关，位于兰路527号的社会运动指导委员会上海分会与13起纠纷有关。案件如下：

上海工会整理委员会涉及的纠纷。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 1941年4月28日 / 特别支部）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 9601 (C)
Date 20/3/41

S. 1, Special Branch /Station/ File No. .................... Date March 19, 1941.

SUBJECT:
General Labour Unrest between February 15
and March 14, 1941.

Between February 15 and March 14, 1941,
32 labour disputes occurred at concerns in the
Settlement and extra-Settlement Roads Area as
against 35 cases recorded between January 15 and
February 14, 1941.

Of this number, strikes were declared in
28 cases, 7 of which were continued from the period
ended February 14. Twenty-six of the strikes,
with the exception of four in which the workers
resumed unconditionally, were brought to an end
through concessions being granted by the management,
while the remaining two were still outstanding on
March 14. These strikes involved a total of
7,223 workers, which figure shows a decrease of
2,571 as compared with the number of strikers
(9,794) during the preceding period.

The 4 remaining labour disputes were cases
of unrest and affected 5,270 workers. Three of
these cases were amicably settled. The other one
was unsettled on March 14.

Details of these disputes are given in an
appendix attached hereto.

A new organisation known as the Shanghai
Municipality Cantonese Restaurant Employees' Lien
Nyi Society (上海市粵菜酒樓茶点職工聯誼會) was established
on February 14 at House 5 Lan Tsung Terrace (蘭),
Mandalay Road.

日期 41年3月20日

S. 1, 特别科 /分局/ 档案号 ____ 日期 1941 年 3 月 19 日。

主题：
1941 年 2 月 15 日至 3 月 14 日期间的普遍劳工骚动。

1941 年 2 月 15 日至 3 月 14 日期间，租界及越界筑路区内的企业发生了 32 起劳资纠纷，而 1941 年 1 月 15 日至 2 月 14 日期间记录的案件为 35 起。

在这些案件中，有 28 起宣布罢工，其中 7 起是从截至 2 月 14 日的时期延续下来的。除 4 起工人无条件复工外，其余 26 起罢工均因管理层做出让步而结束，另外 2 起截至 3 月 14 日仍未解决。这些罢工共涉及 7,223 名工人，与前一时期罢工人数（9,794 人）相比，减少了 2,571 人。

其余 4 起劳资纠纷属于骚动案件，影响了 5,270 名工人。其中 3 起已友好解决。另一起截至 3 月 14 日尚未解决。

这些纠纷的详情见附后的附录。

一个名为“上海市粤菜酒楼茶点职工联谊会”的新组织于 2 月 14 日在曼达莱路兰宗里 5 号成立。

The Shanghai Municipality Labour Unions
Readjustment Committee was formally inaugurated

Chung Hwa Road, Nantao, and the general labour

sponsored by the Wang Ching Wei Regime, and the
other in Nantao, supported by the Shanghai City
Government and the Japanese Special Service

the establishment of the Labour Unions Readjustment
Committee.

SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
S. 1. Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date February 24, 1941.
Subject General Labour Unrest between January 15 and February 14, 1941.
Made by/ ............ and ............ Forwarded by C. D. I. Tabrum

Between January 15 and February 14, 1941,
35 labour disputes occurred at concerns in the
Settlement and extra-Settlement Roads Area as against
49 cases recorded between December 15, 1940 and
January 14, 1941.
Of this number, strikes were declared in 25
cases, one of which was continued from the period
ended January 14, 1941. Eighteen of the strikes were
amicably settled. The remaining seven were unsettled
on February 14. These strikes involved a total
complement of 9,794 workers, which figure shows a
decrease of 11,052 as compared with the number of
strikers (20,846) during the preceeding period.
The remaining 10 labour disputes are cases
of unrest and affected 3,144 workers. All of these
cases were amicably settled.
Details of these disputes are given in an
appendix attached hereto.
During this period, Police records show that
the General Labour Union in the Western District, O.O.L.
had connections with one dispute and the Shanghai
Branch of the Social Movement Direction Committee,
527 Range Road had connections with three disputes.
These cases are as follows :-
Dispute in which the General Labour Union
was connected.
1. China General Omnibus Company (unrest).

制作人/ ____ 和 ____ 转呈人 C. D. I. Tabrum

在1941年1月15日至2月14日期间，
租界及越界筑路区域的各商号共发生35起劳资纠纷，而1940年12月15日至
1941年1月14日期间记录的案件为49起。
在这些案件中，有25起宣布罢工，其中一起是从截至1941年1月14日的时期延续下来的。18起罢工已和平解决。其余7起在2月14日时尚未解决。这些罢工涉及的工人总数为9,794人，与前一时期罢工人数（20,846人）相比，减少了11,052人。
其余10起劳资纠纷属于动荡案件，涉及3,144名工人。所有这些案件均已和平解决。
这些纠纷的详情见附后的附录。
在此期间，警方记录显示，西区的一般工会（General Labour Union，O.O.L.）与一起纠纷有关，而社会运动指导委员会上海分会（地址：兰格路527号）与三起纠纷有关。
这些案件如下：
一般工会参与的纠纷。

（印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 24 JAN. 1941 mB）

Between December 15, 1940 and January 14, 1941,
49 labour disputes occurred in concerns in the
Settlement and on extra-Settlement Roads Area as
against 32 cases recorded between November 15 and
December 14, 1940.

Of this number, strikes were declared in 34
cases, including 2 continued from the period ending
December 14. Thirty-three of the strikes, with the
exception of nine in which the workers resumed
unconditionally, were brought to an end on concessions
being granted by the management of the concerns involved,
while the remaining one was still outstanding on
January 14. These strikes involved a total complement
of 20,846 workers, which shows an increase of 17,448
as compared with the number of strikers (3,398) during
the preceeding period.

The remaining 15 cases, including 4 continued
from last period, were cases of unrest and affected 10,854
workers. All of the cases were amicably settled.

Details of these disputes are given in an
appendix attached hereto.

During this period, Police records show that
four disputes were connected with the General Labour
Union in Western District, O.O.L. and four with the
Shanghai Branch of the Social Movement Direction
Committee, 527 Range Road. These cases are as follows :

1940年12月15日至1941年1月14日期间，租界内及越界筑路区域的企业发生了49起劳资纠纷，而1939年11月15日至12月14日期间记录的案件为32起。

在这些案件中，有34起宣布罢工，其中包括2起从截至12月14日的时期延续下来的案件。除9起工人无条件复工外，其余33起罢工均因相关企业管理层做出让步而结束，另有1起截至1月14日仍未解决。这些罢工共涉及20,846名工人，与上一时期罢工人数（3,398人）相比，增加了17,448人。

其余15起案件（包括4起从上一时期延续下来的案件）为骚乱案件，影响工人10,854名。所有案件均得以和平解决。

这些纠纷的详情见附后的附录。

在此期间，警方记录显示，有四起纠纷与O.O.L.西区总工会有关，四起与位于兰路527号的社会运动指导委员会上海分会有关。这些案件如下：

January 23, 1941.
Afternoon SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 7601(C)
Date 24 / 1/ 41
New China Daily News (editorial) :-
LABOUR DISPUTES IN THE FOREIGN SETTLEMENTS

Labour disputes have successively been taking place during the past half month. The causes of the outbreak of labour disputes are (1) the sharp increase in the prices of commodities which has made the working class of people no longer able to stand such great oppression, and (2) the fast approach of the Lunar New Year which has caused greater difficulties to the workers.
Then labour disputes were rife, irresponsible rumours of malicious intention were fabricated by some people to the effect that a certain labour dispute was instigated by a certain body or a certain labour dispute was controlled and utilized by certain people. As a matter of fact, if we can pay a little attention to the present cost of living in Shanghai and the average income of a worker, then we will not be able to deny the extreme sufferings of the salaried class of people in the maintenance of their livelihood.
Happily for society, the high tide of labour disputes has now shown a gradual ebb as a result of mediation. Certain demands of the workers were accepted and the latter were granted a certain increase in allowance so as to enable them to live a comparatively better life. However, if the prices of commodities are to continue to increase and the value of the old legal tender is to continue to drop, an extension of the labour disputes, which are closely connected with social peace and good order, is still possible.
Now, let us look at present social conditions. An increase in the surcharge on taxes in the two Foreign Settlements is likely to be enforced. The application by public utilities, such as bus and tram services, of an increase in fares has met with the approval of the authorities. Though the price of rice remained stable for a certain period of time as a result of the exertion of efforts towards stabilization by the authorities, yet it again shows an unreasonably sharp increase. Owing to the approach of the Lunar New Year, the prices of all daily necessaries are also daily increasing.
The laying-down of the above conditions explains that due to the issue at random of banknotes by the Chungking Government, the value of the old legal tender has become lower and lower and that the responsible authorities of the Shanghai Foreign Settlements can no longer stabilize the prices of commodities or suppress the control of prices by the traitorous merchants. At the same time, it also explains the maliciousness of the British and American capitalists in "squeezing" China.
The formation of such conditions is a very serious blow to the common people and can never be avoided by an increase in certain allowances. Of course, we do not mean to oppose the acceptance by the capital side of the workers' demands for a betterment of treatment owing to the high cost of living.
Nobody can deny the disorder of the present situation in Shanghai. It is chiefly caused by the insufficiency of political power. Why cannot the New Central

《新华日报》（社论）：-
租界内的劳资纠纷

过去半个月中，劳资纠纷接连发生。引发劳资纠纷的原因是：(1) 物价急剧上涨，使工人阶级再也无法忍受如此巨大的压迫；(2) 农历新年迅速临近，给工人带来了更大的困难。
随后，劳资纠纷盛行，一些人编造了出于恶意的不负责任的谣言，声称某起劳资纠纷是由某个团体煽动的，或者某起劳资纠纷被某些人控制和利用。事实上，如果我们稍加注意上海目前的生活成本和工人的平均收入，我们就不能否认受薪阶层在维持生计方面所遭受的极度苦难。
对社会而言值得庆幸的是，经过调解，劳资纠纷的高潮现已逐渐消退。工人的某些要求被接受，并获得了一定的津贴增加，从而使他们能够过上相对较好的生活。然而，如果物价继续上涨，旧法币的价值继续下跌，那么与社会和平及良好秩序密切相关的劳资纠纷的蔓延仍然是可能的。
现在，让我们看看当前的社会状况。两个外国租界内的附加税可能会被迫征收。公共汽车和有轨电车等公用事业申请增加票价已获当局批准。虽然由于当局努力稳定物价，米价在一段时间内保持稳定，但再次出现不合理的急剧上涨。由于农历新年的临近，所有日常必需品的价格也在逐日上涨。
上述情况的形成说明，由于重庆政府随意发行钞票，旧法币的价值越来越低，上海外国租界的负责当局已无法稳定物价或压制奸商对价格的控制。同时，这也说明了英美资本家“压榨”中国的恶意。
这种情况的形成对普通百姓是一个非常严重的打击，仅靠增加某些津贴是无法避免的。当然，我们并不意味着反对资方因生活成本高而接受工人改善待遇的要求。
无人能否认上海当前局势的混乱。这主要是由政治权力不足造成的。为什么新中央

January 23, 1941. Afternoon Translation.

Government still exercise its political power in the Foreign
Settlements in Shanghai? It is an important and urgent
question to be settled by the New Central Government to-day.
It is also a question of relief for the several million
residents in Shanghai.
The establishment of the Shanghai Branch of
the Central Reserve Bank not only shows the determination
of the New Central Government for the formation of a new
economic structure in China but also shows the Government's
will to stabilize the financial market in Shanghai. This,
no doubt, will be the first step leading to the stabilization
of the livelihood of the people.
Under the extraordinary circumstances in
Shanghai, the stabilization of the financial market is, of
course, an important measure to settle the livelihood question
of the people, but if the political background of Shanghai
cannot be fundamentally improved and the opinions of the
Settlement authorities cannot be fundamentally corrected, the
future of Shanghai will never be a very optimistic one.
The labour disputes during the past half
month are only a sign of a great crisis in the future. We
hope that the Government authorities will pay attention to
this point and every peace worker will understand this point.

Chinese-American Daily News.

1941年1月23日。下午 译文。

政府仍不能在上海的外国租界行使政治权力？这是新中央政府今天需要解决的一个重要且紧迫的问题。这也是关乎上海数百万居民救济的问题。
中央储备银行上海分行的建立，不仅显示了新中央政府在中国建立新经济结构的决心，也显示了政府稳定上海金融市场的意愿。这无疑将是稳定人民生计的第一步。
在上海的特殊情况下，稳定金融市场当然是解决人民生计问题的重要措施，但如果上海的政治背景不能得到根本改善，租界当局的观点不能得到根本纠正，上海的未来绝不会非常乐观。
过去半个月的劳资纠纷只是未来巨大危机的一个迹象。我们希望政府当局注意这一点，每一位和平工作者也能理解这一点。

《中美日报》。

SECRET

December 23, 1940.

General Labour unrest between November 15 and December 14,
1940.

Between November 15 and December 14, 1940,
32 labour disputes occurred in concerns in the
Settlement and on extra-Settlement Roads Area, as
against 25 cases recorded between October 15 and
November 14.

Of this number, strikes were declared in
20 cases, including 1 continued from the period ending
November 14. Eighteen of the strikes, with the
exception of four in which the workers resumed
unconditionally, were brought to an end on concessions
being granted by the management of the concerns
involved, while the remaining two were still
outstanding on December 14. These strikes involved
a total complement of 3,398 workers, which shows
a decrease of 85 as compared with the number of strikers
(3,483) during the preceding period.

The remaining 12 cases, including 1 continued
from last month, were cases of unrest, and affected
3,444 workers. Eight of this number were amicably
settled, while the remaining four remained unsettled
on December 14.

Details of these disputes are given in an
appendix attached hereto.

1940年11月15日至12月14日期间的一般劳工动荡。

1940年11月15日至12月14日期间，租界内及越界筑路区域的企业发生了32起劳资纠纷，而10月15日至11月14日期间记录的案件为25起。

在这些案件中，有20起宣布罢工，其中包括1起从截至11月14日的时期延续下来的案件。除4起工人无条件复工外，其余18起罢工均因相关企业管理层做出让步而结束，另外2起截至12月14日仍未解决。这些罢工共涉及3,398名工人，与前一时期罢工人数（3,483人）相比减少了85人。

SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
S. 1, Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date November 21, 1940.
Subject General Labour Unrest between October 15 and November 14, 1940.
Made by .... and .... Forwarded by D. J. Crawford.

between October 15 and November 14, 1940, 25
labour disputes occurred in concerns in the Settlement
and on extra-Settlement Roads Area, as against 16
cases recorded between September 15 and October 14.
Of this number, strikes were declared in 20
cases, including 2 continued from the period ending
October 14. Nineteen of the strikes, with the exception
of eight in which the workers either resumed
unconditionally or resigned, were brought to an end
on concessions being granted by the management of the
concerns involved, while the remaining one was still
outstanding on November 14. These strikes involved
a total complement of 3,483 workers which shows a
decrease of 5,475 as compared with the number of
strikers (8,958) during the preceding period.
The remaining 5 cases, including 2 continued
from last month, were cases of unrest, and affected
1,950 workers. Four of this number were amicably
settled, while the remaining one showed a partial
settlement, some 32 of the 70 employees concerned
having been paid off by the management.
Details of these disputes are given in an
appendix attached hereto.

in only one case, the strike of workers of the Kung

由 ____ 和 ____ 制作 由 D. J. Crawford 转发。

1940年10月15日至11月14日期间，租界内及越界筑路区域的企业发生了25起劳资纠纷，而9月15日至10月14日期间记录的案件为16起。在这些案件中，有20起宣布罢工，其中包括2起从截至10月14日的时期延续下来的罢工。除8起工人要么无条件复工要么辞职外，其余19起罢工均因相关企业管理层作出让步而结束，而剩下的一起在11月14日仍未解决。这些罢工共涉及3,483名工人，与前一时期罢工人数（8,958人）相比减少了5,475人。
其余5起案件，包括2起从上个月延续下来的案件，属于骚乱案件，影响了1,950名工人。其中4起得到友好解决，而剩下的一起仅部分解决，涉及的70名雇员中有约32人被管理层解雇。
这些纠纷的详情见附后的附录。

Copies not sent

）

Between September 15 and October 14,
1940, 16 labour disputes occurred in factories
in the Settlement and extra-Settlement Roads
Area, as against 22 cases recorded between
August 15 and September 14.

Of the 16 cases under review, strikes
were declared in 13 cases. Eleven of the
strikes, with the exception of one in which
the workers resumed unconditionally were
brought to an end on concessions being granted
by the management of the concerns involved,
while the other two were still outstanding
on October 14. These strikes involved a
total complement of 8,958 workers which shows
an increase of 6,353 as compared with the
number of strikers (2,605) during the preceding
period.

The remaining 3 cases, including 2
continued from the period ending September 14,
are cases of unrest, involving 770 workers.
One of this number was amicably settled while
the other two remained unsettled on October 14.

Details of these disputes are given
in an appendix attached hereto.

在1940年9月15日至10月14日期间，租界及越界筑路区域的工厂发生了16起劳资纠纷，而8月15日至9月14日期间记录的案件为22起。

在受审查的16起案件中，有13起宣布罢工。除了一起工人无条件复工的案件外，其余11起罢工均因相关企业管理层作出让步而结束，另外两起截至10月14日仍未解决。这些罢工共涉及工人总数8,958人，与前一时期罢工人数（2,605人）相比，增加了6,353人。

其余3起案件，包括2起从截至9月14日的时期延续下来的案件，属于骚动性质，涉及工人770人。其中一起已友好解决，另外两起截至10月14日仍未解决。

这些纠纷的详情见附后的附录。

    During the period under review, the
Shanghai General Labour Union (pro-Nanking
Government), Lane 95, 10 Edinburgh Road, O.O.L.,
was very active in local labour circles.  The
following three labour disputes which were
connected with the union came to the notice of
the Police :-
    1/ Shanghai Electric Construction Company
                                    (Strike)
    2/ China General Omnibus Company (Strike)
    3/ Zee Zoong Dao Medicine Shop   (Strike).
The agitators of the Union succeeded in
instigating not only the tramway and bus
employees which operate in the Settlement but
brought those in the French Concession out on
strike simultaneously.  It was the intention
of the Union to cause a general strike in
Shanghai, and efforts were also made during
the latter part of September, in attempting
to coerce the workers of the Shanghai Gas
Company and the Shanghai Waterworks into
declaring a strike but without success.

which existed among the transportation coolies
(casual workers) operating on Jetties Nos. 6 & 7,

Between August 15 and September 14, 1940,
22 labour disputes occurred in factories in the
Settlement and extra-Settlement Roads Area, as
against 26 cases recorded between July 15 and
August 14.

Of the 22 cases under review, strikes were
declared in 13 cases, including three continued
from the period ending August 14. All of this
number, with the exception of four cases in which
the workers resumed unconditionally and one the
settlement of which was pending, were brought to
an end on concessions being granted by the management
of the concerns involved. These strikes involved
a total complement of 2,605 workers which shows a
decrease of 32 as compared with the number of
strikers( 2,637 ) during the preceding period.

The remaining 9 cases, including one
continued from the period ending August 14, are
cases of unrest. Seven of this number were
amicably settled while the other two remained
unsettled on September 14.

Details of these disputes are given in an
appendix attached hereto.

During the period under review, Police
records reveal that one labour dispute, i.e.
unrest among the workers of the Tsing Foong Silk
Weaving Factory, was connected with the Shanghai

在1940年8月15日至9月14日期间，
租界及越界筑路区域的工厂发生了
22起劳资纠纷，而7月15日至
8月14日期间记录的案件为26起。

在审查的22起案件中，有13起宣布
罢工，其中包括3起延续自截至8月14日的
时期。除4起案件中工人无条件复工以及1起
案件尚待解决外，其余案件均因相关企业的
管理层作出让步而告终。这些罢工共涉及
2,605名工人，与前一时期罢工人数
（2,637人）相比，减少了32人。

其余9起案件，包括1起延续自截至8月14日的
时期，属于骚动案件。其中7起已
友好解决，另外2起截至9月14日仍
未解决。

这些纠纷的详情见附后的附录。

工人的骚动，与上海

REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B. REGISTRY File No. 9601 28/8/40 Date August 21, 1940.）

Subject General Labour Unrest between July 15 and August 14, 1940.

Made by ____________________ and ____________________ Forwarded by D. S. I. Logan.

Between July 15 and August 14, 1940,
26 labour disputes occurred in factories in the
Settlement and extra-Settlement Roads Area, as
against 49 cases recorded between June 15 and
July 14.

Strikes were declared in 16 cases.
Thirteen of the strikes, with the exception of
two cases in which the workers resumed uncondi-
tionally, were brought to an end on concessions
being granted by the management of the concerns
involved. The remaining 3 cases remained
outstanding on August 14, with the exception
of one case which showed a partial resumption,
some 240 out of the 300 workers concerned having
resumed work on concessions being granted by
their respective employers. These strikes
involved a total complement of 2,637 workers
which shows a decrease of 3,151 as compared
with the number of strikers (5,788) during the
preceding period.

The remaining 10 cases including
one continued from the period ending July 14, are
cases of unrest. Nine of this number were
amicably settled while the other one remained

〔签名〕

Between June 15 and July 14, 1940,
49 labour disputes occurred in factories in the
Settlement and extra-Settlement Roads area, as
against 41 cases recorded between May 15 and
June 14.

Of those 49 cases under review, strikes
were declared in thirty-four cases, including
three continued from the month ending June 14.
Twenty-nine of the strikes were brought to an
end after concessions had been granted by the
management of the concerns involved, and the
remaining five strikes were settled unconditionally.
These strikes involved a total complement of
5,788 workers which shows a decrease of 7,542
as compared with the number of strikers (13,330)
during the preceding period.

The remaining 15 cases including one
continued from the period ending April 14, are
cases of unrest. Eleven of this number were
amicably settled on concessions being granted
by the managements, three unconditionally, and
other remained unsettled on July 14.

Details of these disputes are given
in an appendix attached hereto.

**〔此处转录不清〕**
Date June 21 1940.

Subject General Labour Unrest between May 15, and June 14, 1940.

Made by ________ and ________ Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

Between May 15 and June 14, 1940, 41 labour disputes occurred in factories in the Settlement and extra-Settlement Roads Area, as against 35 cases recorded between April 15 and May 14.

Out of this number strikes were declared in 29 cases, including four continued from the month ending May 14. Twenty-six of the strikes were amicably settled whilst three remained outstanding on June 14. These strikes involved a total complement of 13,330 workers, which shows an increase of 600 as compared with the number of strikers (12,730) during the preceding period.

During the period under review, twelve cases of unrest occurred. Eleven of this number were settled while one, which continued from the period ending May 14, remained unsettled by June 14.

Details of these disputes are given in an appendix attached hereto.

Police records reveal that two of the disputes were connected with the "China Labour Movement Association", a pro-Wang Ching Wei organization with offices at Lane 95, 10 Edinburgh Road, and three cases with the "Chinese Labourers' Welfare Association", a Japanese sponsored organization with head office at Yung Foong Fong, North Szechuen Road, O.O.L.. 日期：1940年6月21日。

主题：1940年5月15日至6月14日期间的一般劳工骚乱。

由 ________ 和 ________ 编制，由警司 Crawford 转呈

1940年5月15日至6月14日期间，租界及越界筑路区的工厂发生了 41 起劳资纠纷，而 4月15日至5月14日期间记录的案件为 35 起。

在这些案件中，有 29 起宣布罢工，其中包括从截至5月14日的那个月延续下来的四起。其中二十六起罢工已和平解决，另有三起截至6月14日仍未解决。这些罢工涉及的工人总数为 13,330 人，与前一时期罢工人数（12,730 人）相比增加了 600 人。

在审查期间，发生了十二起骚乱案件。其中十一件已获解决，另有一件是从截至5月14日的时期延续下来的，截至6月14日仍未解决。

这些纠纷的详情见附后的附录。

警方记录显示，其中两起纠纷与“中华劳工运动协会”有关，这是一个亲汪精卫的组织，办事处位于爱丁堡路 10 号 95 弄；另有三起案件与“中国劳工福利协会”有关，这是一个由日本赞助的组织，总部设在越界筑路区北四川路永丰坊。这些案件如下：-

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 23 MAY 1940）

Between April 15 and May 14, 1940, 35 labour disputes occurred in factories in the Settlement and extra-Settlement Roads Area, as against 31 cases recorded between March 15 and April 14.

Strikes were declared in 30 cases, including one continued from the period ending April 14. Of this number twenty-six were settled amicably and in several cases workers resumed unconditionally, while the other four remained outstanding on May 14. These strikes involved a total of 12,730 workers, which shows an increase of 6,751 as compared with the preceding period.

During the period under review, five cases of unrest occurred and, of this number, four including one continued from the period ending April 14, were settled while one remained unsettled on May 14.

Details of these disputes are given in an appendix attached hereto.

During the month under review, the Chinese Labourers' Welfare Association, sponsored by the Japanese, and the China Labour Movement Association, a pro-Wang Ching Wei organization with offices at Lane 95, 10 Edinburgh Road, were comparatively quiet. Police records reveal that two labour disputes, the strike of workers of the China Import and Export

1940年4月15日至5月14日期间，租界及越界筑路地区的工厂发生了35起劳资纠纷，而3月15日至4月14日期间记录的案件为31起。

宣布罢工的案件有30起，其中包括一起从截至4月14日的时期延续下来的案件。在这30起案件中，26起已和平解决，且在几起案件中工人无条件复工，其余4起截至5月14日仍未解决。这些罢工共涉及12,730名工人，与前一时期相比增加了6,751人。

在审查期间，发生了5起骚乱案件，其中4起（包括一起从截至4月14日的时期延续下来的案件）已得到解决，另一起截至5月14日仍未解决。

这些纠纷的详情见附后的附录。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S.P.B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 9601
Date April 18, 1940

Subject General Labour Unrest between March 15 and April 14, 1940.

Made by. C.D.I. Sih Tse Liang Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

Commr of Police
Sir:
I have the honour to submit herewith Report on General Labour Unrest between March 15 and April 14, 1940.

R.G. Yorke.
D. C. (Sp. Br.)

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 19 APR. 1940）

FILE

DATE 19/ 4 / 40

Between March 15 and April 14, 1940,
31 disputes occurred in factories in the Settlement
and extra-Settlement Roads Area, as against 38
cases recorded between February 15 and March 14.
Strikes were declared in 18 cases, which
figure includes four continued from the month
ending March 14. Seventeen of the strikes
were amicably settled, but one remained outstanding
on April 14. These strikes involved a total
complement of 5,979 workers, which is a decrease
of 10,466 as compared with the number of strikers
(16,445) during the preceding period.
During the period under review, 13 cases
of unrest occurred and, of this number, twelve
were settled while one remained unsettled on
April 14.
Details of these disputes are given in
an appendix attached hereto.
The China Labour Movement Association,
a pro-Wang Ching Wei organization with offices
at Lane 95, 10 Edinburgh Road, O.O.L., continues
its activities in attempting to secure control
over local labour. Two cases of disputes
connected with the association came to the notice
of the Police, i.e. the strike of 920 workers of
the local Stocking Dyeing Establishments, and the
unrest among 300 workers of the Bean Curd Shops.

主题 1940年3月15日至4月14日期间的一般劳工骚乱。

撰写人：侦探督察 施子良 转呈人：侦探督察 克劳福德

警务处长
阁下：
谨此呈报1940年3月15日至4月14日期间的一般劳工骚乱报告。

R.G. Yorke.
副总监（特务科）

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处处长办公室 1940年4月19日）

归档

日期 19/ 4 / 40

1940年3月15日至4月14日期间，
租界及越界筑路地区的工厂发生了31起纠纷，
而2月15日至3月14日期间记录的案件为38起。
其中18起宣布罢工，该数字包括
截至3月14日的那个月延续下来的四起。
十七起罢工得以和平解决，但有一起
在4月14日仍未解决。这些罢工共涉及
5,979名工人，与前一时期罢工人数
（16,445人）相比减少了10,466人。
在审查期间，发生了13起骚乱案件，
其中十二起已解决，另一起
在4月14日仍未解决。
这些纠纷的详情见附后的附录。
中国劳工运动协会是一个亲汪精卫的组织，
其办事处位于爱丁堡路10弄95号，O.O.L.，
继续其试图控制当地劳工的活动。
有两起与该协会有关的纠纷案件
引起警方注意，即当地袜厂染整业
920名工人的罢工，以及豆腐店
300名工人的骚乱。

Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SIDE REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 9601
Date March 28, 1940

Subject General Labour Unrest between February 15 and March 14, 1940.

Made by C.D.I. Sih Tee Liang Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

Between February 15 and March 14, no less than 38 labour disputes occurred in factories in the Settlement and extra-Settlement roads areas, as against 27 cases recorded between January 15 and February 14.

Of this number, strikes were declared in 27 cases, including two continued from the month ending February 14. Twenty-three of the strikes were amicably settled, whilst four remain outstanding. These strikes involved a total complement of 16,445 workers, which is an increase of 7,822 as compared with the number of strikers (8,623) during the preceding period.

During the period under review, eleven cases of unrest occurred and of these seven were settled and four still pending on March 14. In addition, one case of unrest which commenced during the previous period, culminated in the strike of 3,200 coolies of the F.W.D. (Included in the number of strikes settled).

Details of these disputes are given in an appendix attached hereto.

It is worthy of note that during the period under review, there was an increase of 11 cases of labour trouble compared with the previous period. This increase is chiefly due to the influence of outside authorities aimed at gaining control over local labour circles. Police records reveal

主题 1940年2月15日至3月14日期间的一般劳工骚动。

撰写人：侦探督察 梁锡蒂 (Sih Tee Liang) 转呈人：督察 克劳福德 (Crawford)

2月15日至3月14日期间，租界及越界筑路区域的工厂发生了不少于38起劳资纠纷，而1月15日至2月14日期间记录的案件为27起。

在这些案件中，有27起宣布罢工，其中包括两起延续自截至2月14日当月的罢工。其中23起罢工已和平解决，另有4起尚未解决。这些罢工共涉及16,445名工人，与前一时期罢工人数（8,623人）相比，增加了7,822人。

在审查期间，发生了11起骚动案件，其中7起已解决，4起截至3月14日仍悬而未决。此外，一起在前一时期开始的骚动案件，最终演变为远东仓库（F.W.D.）3,200名苦力的罢工（计入已解决的罢工数量中）。

这些纠纷的详情见附后的附录。

值得注意的是，在审查期间，劳工纠纷案件比前一时期增加了11起。这一增加主要是由于外部势力旨在控制当地劳工界的影响所致。警方记录显示

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. ____ 9601
Date February 20, 1940.

Subject General Labour Unrest between January 15, 1940 and
February 14, 1940.

Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse Liang Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

With the steady increase in the cost of
living continually forming the principal factor of
unrest, the situation in the sphere of local labour
showed little sign of improvement by February 14, 1940.
During the period between January 15 and February 14,
no less than twenty-seven cases of disputes were
recorded as against forty-six cases recorded
between December 15, 1939 and January 14, 1940.
Of these labour disputes, strikes were
declared in 20 cases affecting 8,623 workers.
Eighteen of the strikes were brought to an end
following concessions being granted by the management,
while the other two remained unsettled.

Seven cases of unrest took place during the
same period, of which four was amicably settled while
the remainder were in the course of settlement.
Details of these disputes are given in an
appendix attached hereto.

In the majority of labour disputes which
occurred in the Eastern Area of the Settlement, the
Eastern District Branch of the Chinese Labourers'
Welfare Association, a Japanese sponsored organization
with offices at 127 Rangoon Road continued to take an
active part.

Sih Tse Liang
C. D. I.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科第一股
报告
档案号 ____ 9601
日期 1940年2月20日。

主题 1940年1月15日至2月14日期间的一般劳工骚乱。

呈报人 侦探督察 施子良 转呈人 副督察 克劳福德

随着生活成本的稳步上升持续成为骚乱的主要因素，截至1940年2月14日，本地劳工领域的局势鲜有改善迹象。在1月15日至2月14日期间，记录的纠纷案件不少于27起，而1939年12月15日至1940年1月14日期间记录的案件为46起。在这些劳资纠纷中，有20起宣布罢工，涉及8,623名工人。其中18起罢工在管理层做出让步后得以结束，另外两起仍未解决。

同期发生了七起骚乱案件，其中四起已友好解决，其余正在解决过程中。这些纠纷的详情见附后的附录。

在租界东区发生的大多数劳资纠纷中，设有办公室于兰路127号的、由日本人赞助的组织“中国劳工福利协会”东区分会继续积极参与。

施子良
侦探督察

SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch.
REPORT
File No. ____
No. S. B. ____
Date January 17, 1940.

Subject General Labour Unrest between December 15, 1939 and
January 14, 1940.

Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse Liang Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

（批：Copy to
Messrs Huder
E.）

The wave of labour unrest because of the
high cost of living, which manifested itself during
November, 1939, showed no sign of abating by the
14th of January, 1940. A total of 46 cases were
recorded during the period from December 15, 1939 to
January 14, 1940 as against 28 during the period,
November to December 14, 1939. Of the 46 cases
during the period under review, strikes were
declared in 22 cases which affected 6,978 workers.
With the exception of a small number of cases in
which the workers resumed unconditionally, the
settlement of the other cases was brought about on
concessions being granted by the management of the
concerns involved. One strike mentioned in the
previous resume, showed a partial resumption, some
90 out of the 250 workers concerned having resumed
work unconditionally.

In the remaining 24 cases, unrest was
removed in 17 of these cases after concessions had
been granted by the managements while the settlement
of the remaining 7 cases is still pending.

The Eastern District Branch of the Chinese
Labourers' Welfare Association, 127 Rangoon Road,
continues to take an active interest in almost
all cases of labour disputes in the Eastern District.

Lists of the different cases under review are
attached hereto.

（印：R.D. [签名]
A.C. (Sp. Br.)）

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE
18 JAN. 1940）

（批：C. 18/1
19 1 . 40
Im）

Sih Tse Liang
C. D. I.
A.C. (Special Branch)

机密
上海公共租界警务处。
特科第一股。
报告
档案号 ____
特科编号 S. B. ____
日期 1940年1月17日。

主题 1939年12月15日至1940年1月14日期间的一般劳工骚动。

由 特别调查员 Sih Tse Liang 制作 经由 督察长 Crawford 转呈

（批：抄送
Huder 先生
E.）

由于生活费用高昂引发的劳工骚动浪潮在1939年11月显现，至1940年1月14日并无减弱迹象。在1939年12月15日至1940年1月14日期间，共记录案件46起，而1939年11月至12月14日期间为28起。在所审查期间的46起案件中，有22起宣布罢工，影响工人6,978名。除少数案件中工人无条件复工外，其余案件的解决均得益于相关公司资方作出的让步。前次综述中提到的一次罢工显示部分复工，涉及的250名工人中约有90人已无条件复工。

在其余24起案件中，有17起在资方作出让步后消除了骚动，其余7起案件的解决仍待决。

位于兰格路127号的华人劳工福利协会东区分会继续积极关注东区几乎所有的劳资纠纷案件。

所审查的各类案件清单附后。

SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. ____ 7601
Date December 16, 1939.

Subject General Labour Unrest Up to December 14, 1939.

Made by C.D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by D.I. Crawford

A sudden wave of general labour unrest on the grounds of high cost of living in consequence of the increase in the price of commodities manifested itself during November, 1939. The grievances which the labour side professes to have at present may be summarized as follows:-
(1) Rice allowance.
(2) Increase in pay.
(3) Bonuses.
(4) Better treatment.
(5) No dismissal without good reason.

Since then no less than 25 industrial concerns employing 14,083 hands, and 3 departmental stores with 1,850 employees have been involved.

Of the total of 28 cases, a strike or a "go-slow" strike was declared in 16 cases. Nine of the strikes were settled following the granting of concessions by the managements; but the remaining 7 cases were still without a solution on December 14, 1939, the number of workers out on that day being 5,134.

The remaining 12 cases are cases of unrest. In 9 of the cases of unrest, negotiations have been in progress between the employers and employees, and up to the present the workers have not resorted to any illegal action in order to enforce their demands. With regard to other three cases of unrest, the workers have not taken any definite steps up to

主题：截至1939年12月14日的普遍劳工动荡情况。

制作人：侦探督察 施子良（Sih Tse-liang） 转呈人：侦探督察 克劳福德（Crawford）

1939年11月期间，由于商品价格上涨导致生活成本高昂，引发了一股突如其来的普遍劳工动荡浪潮。劳工方面目前声称的不满可概括如下：
(1) 米贴。
(2) 加薪。
(3) 奖金。
(4) 改善待遇。
(5) 无正当理由不得解雇。

此后，涉及不少于25家雇用14,083名工人的工业企业，以及3家雇用1,850名员工的百货公司。

在总共28起案件中，有16起宣布罢工或“怠工”。其中9起罢工在资方作出让步后得以解决；但截至1939年12月14日，其余7起案件仍未解决，当日停工工人人数为5,134人。

其余12起案件属于动荡状态。在9起动荡案件中，雇主与雇员之间正在进行谈判，截至目前，工人尚未采取任何非法行动来强制实现其要求。至于另外三起动荡案件，工人迄今尚未采取任何明确步骤向其各自的管理层

（左侧批注：G科 机密）

Shing Tsung, Edinburgh Road, C.O.L. (established during December, 1939) held a secret meeting at 110 Tsau Ah Pang, Gordon Road, and decided to induce the workers in the Western District to demand an increase in wages and allowances because of the growing cost of living.

In addition to the Chinese Labourers' Welfare Association, the Special Service Corps of the Chung Kuo Kuomintang Anti-Comintern and National Salvation Army (Wang Ching Wei Clique), headquarters at 76 Jessfield Road, O.O.L., is also taking an interest in the labour agitation in the Western District.

Here again, it is necessary to point out that in the Western District there are no less than 17 Japanese mills employing 22,297 hands. Despite the present unrest in other concerns, none of these mills are affected although the workers of Japanese mills in the past have been the most recalcitrant of the lot. Another point worthy of note is that the welfare of these labourers has not had the attention of the agents of the Japanese sponsored organizations.

An unconfirmed report is to the effect that interested parties are engineering a general strike of all industrial plants including public utility concerns of Chinese and foreign ownership other than Japanese in March, 1940.

Sih Tschiang
C. D. I.

除了“中国劳工福利会”外，总部设在外滩杰斯菲尔德路（Jessfield Road，即兆丰公园路，现中山公园附近，此处原文O.O.L.可能指Outside Limits或特定区域代码，通常译作越界筑路区或类似含义，但结合上下文76号地址，实为极司菲尔路）76号的“中国国民党反共救国军”（汪精卫派系）特别服务队，也对西区的劳工煽动活动感兴趣。

在此再次有必要指出，西区拥有不少于17家日本纱厂，雇用工人22,297名。尽管其他企业目前存在动荡，但这些纱厂均未受到影响，尽管过去日本纱厂的工人一直是最难对付的群体。另一点值得注意的是，这些劳工的福利并未受到日本人赞助组织代理人的关注。

有一份未经证实的报告称，利益相关方正在策划于1940年3月对所有工业企业（包括中日以外的中外_owned_公用事业企业）发动总罢工。

Between September 15 and October 14, 
1940, 16 labour disputes occurred in factories 
in the Settlement and extra-Settlement Roads 
Area, as against 22 cases recorded between 
August 15 and September 14. 

Of the 16 cases under review, strikes 
were declared in 13 cases. Bleven of the 
strikes, with the exception of one in which 
the workers resumed unconditionally were 
brought to an end on concessions being granted 
by the management of the concerns involved, 
while the other two were still outstanding 
on October 14. these strikes involved a 
total complement of 8,958 workers which shows 
an increase of 6,353 as compared with the 
number of strikers (2,605) during the preceding 
period. 

The remaining 3 cases, including 2 
continued from the period ending September 14, 
are cases of unrest, involving 770 workers. 

One of this number was amicably settled while 
the other two remained unsettled on October 14. 

Details of these disputes are given 

in an appendix attached hereto.

Between May 15 and June 14, 1940, 41 labour 
disputes occurred in factories in the Settlement 
and extra-Settlement Roads Area, as against 35 
cases recorded between April 15 and May 14. 

Out of this number strikeea were declared in 
29 cases, including four continued from the month 
ending May 14. Twenty-six of the strikes were 
amicably settled whilst three remained outstanding 
on June 14. These strikes involved a total 
complement of 13,330 workers, which shows an 
increase of 600 as compared with the number of 
strikers (12,730) during the preceding period. 

During the period under review, twelve 
cases of unrest occurred. Eleven of this number 
were settled while one, which continued from the 
period ending May 14, remained unsettled by June 14. 

Details of these disputes are given in an 
appendix attached hereto. 

Police records reveal that two of the 
disputes were connected with the "China Labour 
Movement Association’, a pro-Wang Ching Wei 
organization with offices at Lane 95, 10 Hdinburgh 
Road, and three cases with the ‘Chinese Labourers! 
Welfare Association’, a Japanese sponsored 
organization with head office at Yung Foong Fong, 
North Szechuen Road, 0.0.L.. These cases are as

Subject. .General Labour Unrest Up to December 14, 1939. 001 


A sudden wave of general labour unrest on the 
grounds of high cost of living in consequence of the 
increase in the price of commodities manifested 


itself during November, 1939. The grievances which 


the labour side professes to have at present may be 
summarized as follows:= i 
(1) Rice allowance. 
(2) Increase in pay. 
(3) Bonuses. 
(4) Better treatment. 
(5) No dismissal without good reason. 
; Since then no less than 25 industrial concerns 
employing 14,083 hands, and 3 departmental stores 
with 1,850 employees have been involved. 
Of the total of 28 cases, a strike or a "“go-slow" 
strike was declared in 16 cases. Nine of the 
strikes were settled following the granting of 
coucessions by the managements; but the remaining 
7 cases were still without a solution on December JA: » 
1959, the number of workers out on that day being 
5,134. 
The remaining 12 cases are cases of unrest. H 


In § of the cases of unrest, negotiations have been | 


in progress between the employers and employees, and 
up to the present the workers have not resorted 


to any illegal action in order to enforce their 


demands. With regard to other three cases of unrest, 


the workers have not taken any definite steps up to
